# Fixtures

Two kinds of fixtures back the inference rules:

1. **Synthetic Git histories** with known ownership, built in tests or checked in as small scripts. These are ground truth.
2. **Sanitized real logs** from supported Claude Code and Codex versions, organized by agent and CLI version (for example `claude_code/<version>/`, `codex/<version>/`). These need manual labels before they count as ground truth.

Never commit raw transcripts. Before adding a real log, remove prompts, file contents unrelated to the test, absolute home paths, tokens and keys, and anything identifying private code.

## Current fixtures

Generated by `build_fixtures.py` (all values invented; shapes from [docs/log-audit.md](../../docs/log-audit.md)):

| Fixture | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| `claude_code/2.1/session.jsonl` | Write (create), Edit with original file, failed Edit, Bash, user-modified Edit, call with no result, usage repeated per content block |
| `codex/0.98-patch-text/rollout.jsonl` | apply_patch text only, exit-code success, verification failure, shell command, repeated token counts |
| `codex/0.144-file-change/rollout.jsonl` | FileChange linked by call ID, FileChange from an exec cell (linked by order), add with content, counter reset |
| `codex/0.153-subagent/rollout.jsonl` | Subagent with copied parent history, delete and multi-file FileChange |

Required fixture scenarios are listed in the project specification (verification and release acceptance).
